#: 2026-10-27 panther diag3 (115b): D3D11 cube GPU hang on v10 (also in 114). diag3 driver = 115 + wait trace with 32-bit SYNC_SETs (diag's SYNC_SET64 was CS fatal 0x49), desc ringbuf wait traced, heap state + CSF event drain + CS_EVENT_SIGNAL nudge at the 10 s queue timeout. Candidates: v10 FRAG iterator restore, heap renewal cadence, heap max chunks. Deep-merged over assets/gameloop.json.
#warmupSec: after the first frame; the measured window is [warmupSec, warmupSec + measureSec] seconds after it
#tailSec: self-timed tests (secsEnv) run warmupSec + measureSec + tailSec seconds, then exit on their own
#startTimeoutSec: a pass with no first frame after this many seconds is stopped and marked failed
#screenshotAtSec: PNG of the display (game + DXVK HUD) this many seconds after the first frame; -1 = none
#driver: bundled = the driver this APK carries (default), selected = the launcher's choice, or a driver id
#env: every pass (DXVK_HUD stays full: ContainerManager owns it)
#envSets: one per pass. A/B (scenario 4): 'old' = every default-on 115 perf knob (staging-115 pa, pb, pc NOTES.md) at its 114 value, 'default' = driver defaults. Opt-in knobs (PANVK_KBASE_COHERENT_POOLS, PANVK_KBASE_EVICTABLE, PANVK_KBASE_HEAP_SLOTS) stay unset in both. PANVK_ZS_PRELOAD_ALWAYS is not in 'old': 114 already used INTERSECT on v11 (csf-v11 061); on a v9/v10 device add PANVK_ZS_PRELOAD_ALWAYS=1 for a full 114 set.

old.note: 115 perf knobs at their 114 values (pa 8, pb 8, pc 5)

d3-plain.note: diag3 driver, defaults (no trace): timeout-time dumps only

d3-iter.note: diag3, wait trace, v10 FRAG iterator restore

d3-rn16.note: diag3, wait trace, heap renewal every 16 tiler submits

d3-norn.note: diag3, wait trace, heap renewal off

d3-ch1600.note: diag3, wait trace, heap max 1600 chunks

#tasks: shortcut = PanPlay shortcut id (built-in cubes: builtin-<api>-<arch>). Add a task here and name it in a scenario.

tasks.#d3d12: D3D12 through vkd3d-proton (VKD3D component) and DXVK dxgi: no DXVK HUD or DXVK stats, so fps is the driver fps log (csf-v11 233); the test's own average is in its PASS line (test.fps). Sources: tests/dx12.

#scenarios: Firebase --scenario-numbers. Numbers 1..N without gaps (the build sets com.google.test.loops = N). Passes: each task in order, one per env set in order.
